text.card: A red giant 1,062 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.95 solar masses and 6.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,679 K at its surface.
